The self-renewing cells have many of the properties… 8891333 targeted-therapy-for-cancer-stem-cells:-the-patched-pathway-and-abc-transporters targeted therapy cancer stem cells patched pathway abc Data from certain leukemias as well as brain and breast cancer indicate that there is a small population of tumor cells Targeted therapy for cancer stem cells: the patched pathway and ABC transporters Data from certain leukemias as well as brain and breast cancer indicate that there is a small population of tumor cells with ‘stem cell’ characteristics and the capacity for self-renewal. The self-renewing cells have many of the properties of normal stem cells and have been termed ‘cancer stem cells’. These cancer stem cells make up as few as 1% of the cells in a tumor, making them difficult to detect and study. Like normal stem cells, cancer stem cells have a number of properties permitting them to survive traditional cancer chemotherapy and radiation therapy.
